name: cavemio-split-pane
title: Split pane
description: A desktop-grade resizable dual panel. Zero-lag drag, rubber-band spring limits, and double-click preset snapping.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The divider button acts as a semantic role="separator" with aria-valuenow.
- Arrow keys step by 1% (10% with Shift); Enter snaps to 50/50; Home and End jump to minimum and maximum limits.
- Past boundary limits, WAAPI springFrames computes 33 keyframe values for fluid physical return.
- Reduced motion removes transitions and settles snapped positions immediately.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: first / second
props.description: – · Content rendered inside the left/top and right/bottom panes.

props.name: split / defaultSplit
props.description: 50 · Controlled or initial percentage allocated to the first pane.

props.name: minSize / maxSize
props.description: 15 / 85 · Boundary thresholds in percentage before rubber-band resistance begins.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: true · Enables pane collapse buttons on the divider.

props.name: disabled
props.description: false · Locks the divider in place and prevents resizing.

props.name: onSplitChange
props.description: – · Fired during pointer movement with raw split percentages.

props.name: onSplitCommit
props.description: – · Fired upon pointer release or keyboard snap with normalized value.

useCases.description: An editor on one side and a live preview on the other.

useCases.title: Master and detail layouts
useCases.description: A list on the left with the selected item on the right.

useCases.title: Consoles and logs

features.title: Dragging with no lag
features.description: The divider updates the panes directly, without React re-rendering them.

features.title: Rubber-band limits
features.description: Pulling past the minimum or maximum meets resistance, then springs back.

features.title: Double-click to snap
features.description: Double-clicking the divider eases between 50/50, 25/75 and 75/25.

features.title: Collapse either pane
features.description: Arrows on the divider fold a pane away so the other fills the frame.

features.title: Horizontal or vertical
features.description: Split side by side or top and bottom.

features.title: Keyboard control
features.description: The divider is a separator: arrow keys step by 1% (10% with Shift), Enter snaps to 50/50, and Home and End jump to the limits.

states.title: resize
states.description: Divider movement updates pane flex-basis directly without React state re-renders.

states.title: rubber-band
states.description: Dragging beyond min/max bounds introduces logarithmic resistance; release triggers a WAAPI spring back.

states.title: snap
states.description: Double-clicking the divider smoothly animates between 50/50, 25/75, and 75/25 presets over 380ms.

states.title: collapse
states.description: Collapse arrows fold either pane to 0 width, docking the thin line divider flush against the frame.
